summary.recommended_prediction_strategy: Hybrid Agronomic Baseline + Growing Degree-Days (GDD) + Near-term Weather Adjustments
summary.production_machine_learning_status: Supervised ML training deferred until verified on-farm sowing and harvest observation records are logged. Architecture prepared with scikit-learn training pipeline.

kaggle_crop_production.data_provenance: Aggregated annual/seasonal district-level statistics published by Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
kaggle_crop_production.suitability_for_harvest_date_prediction: Unsuitable for direct supervised harvest date prediction.
kaggle_crop_production.suitability_explanation: The dataset records macro-level annual crop area (hectares) and total production (metric tonnes) by season and district. It does NOT record micro-level field sowing dates, flowering dates, harvest dates, or days-to-maturity. Constructing a supervised ML target for harvest window from this dataset would require manufacturing synthetic dates, which is methodologically invalid and scientifically misleading.
kaggle_crop_production.recommended_usage: Auxiliary regional agricultural context: identifying predominant regional crops, crop seasons (Kharif, Rabi, Zaid, Whole Year), and district-level historical crop prevalence.

hf_crop_yield.primary_purpose: Crop yield prediction (metric tonnes per hectare) based on soil, district, and weather proxies.
hf_crop_yield.suitability_for_harvest_date_prediction: Unsuitable as supervised training labels for harvest timing.
hf_crop_yield.suitability_explanation: The dataset focuses on agricultural yield and input factors. While valuable for yield and production forecasting, it lacks daily phenological progression timestamps. Yield cannot be treated as a proxy for days remaining until maturity.
hf_crop_yield.recommended_usage: Supporting regional yield context and seasonal validation; excluded from supervised harvest date model training.

hf_crop_disease_images.primary_purpose: Computer vision classification for foliar crop diseases and leaf pathogens.
hf_crop_disease_images.data_modality: Images (RGB JPG/PNG) with disease diagnosis labels.
hf_crop_disease_images.suitability_for_harvest_date_prediction: Unsuitable for harvest window timing prediction.
hf_crop_disease_images.suitability_explanation: The dataset contains leaf disease pathology images without longitudinal growth timelines, sowing records, or harvest timestamps. Downloading multi-gigabyte image sets for harvest timing prediction is unnecessary and inappropriate.
hf_crop_disease_images.recommended_usage: Preserved for future crop health, foliar inspection, and pest/pathology diagnostic modules.

missing_fields_for_supervised_training: actual_harvest_date (exact calendar date when crop reached physiological maturity or harvest)
variety_identifier (specific cultivar e.g., HD-2967, Lokwan, Basmati-1121)
geo_coordinates (farm-level latitude and longitude for daily microclimate matching)
daily_temperature_series (observed daily min/max temperatures throughout growth cycle)
